grammar.title: Going to — Planos Futuros
rules: "Be going to" expressa planos e intenções futuras já decididas: I'm going to travel next month.
Estrutura: subject + am/is/are + going to + verb: She is going to book a hotel.
Negativo: am/is/are + not + going to: We're not going to forget the tickets.
